description: Recent open-market insider purchases (SEC Form 4, transaction code P) by executives, directors and 10% owners at US companies with a market value of about $1B or more and a purchase of $250K or more. Private placements, IPO allocations, DRIP and ESPP purchases are excluded. Filter by ticker, look-back window, minimum size or executives only. Flags cluster buying (several insiders buying the same stock within 14 days).

executives_only.description: Only CEO, CFO, COO, President and Chair purchases

min_value_usd.description: Only purchases at or above this dollar amount

symbol.description: Optional US ticker to filter, e.g. SOFI

name: get_insider_buys
title: Insider open-market purchases (Form 4)
